title.zh: Hyperliquid Policy Center backs CFTC in fight over perpetual futures, asks court to drop CME’s case

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid Policy Center backs the CFTC in a lawsuit filed by CME Group over perpetual futures, arguing that CME's case stifles innovation and asking the court to dismiss it.
